subject: Fix arms.py: run the REAL eager-judge on autowire candidates (replace ceScore threshold) — production-faithful ON-arm
description:
Correct the SDK canonical ON-arm (bench/zonoid_bench/arms.py, on the feature branch) per note (the OVERRIDE eager-judge decision). Replace the ceScore>0.2 threshold wiring with the REAL daemon eager-judge over the autowire candidate set:

1. client.py: add `judge_next(base_url, node, budget, workspace=None)` → GET /judge/next?node=&budget=&workspace=.
2. arms.run_canonical_wiring: mint probe-as-task (drop_task_stub + post_status not_ready+summary) so autowire seeds candidate edges (cosine≥0.55 + CE) → GET /judge/next?node=<probe> → for each candidate run the LLM judge (judge.EdgeJudge, default prune) → POST /judge/verdict keepEdge/pruneEdge → read get_task_context. REMOVE the task_suggest+ceScore+overlay_edge(createEdge) path.
3. LIVE-WORKSPACE constraint (note-mqh0gwz1mxc, note-mqgwrh5a63x): keepEdge persists only on the daemon's live state.workspace. So run the unit as the embedded daemon's LIVE workspace (extend daemon.py with a workspace param that sets ORCH_WORKSPACE/cwd; one daemon per conversation OR re-point per conversation). Verify keepEdge actually surfaces in /task/context (the spike's failure mode was empty context_keys).
4. Update arms.py --smoke + re-run the S7 integration smoke to confirm: ON answer correct when the evidence session IS an autowire candidate; cold fails; and crucially that the kept edge persisted (came from the eager-judge, not createEdge). Report the HONEST behavior on a sub-0.55 evidence session.

Scope: arms.py + client.py (+ daemon.py workspace param if needed) + the smoke. Keep run_agent_in_container / run_cold / run_rag_control. This supersedes the ceScore approach; agent-memory migration (S8) re-points to this after.

summary: feat(bench/sdk): production-faithful ON-arm — LLM EdgeJudge + hang-protection. client.judge_next added; arms.run_canonical_wiring uses real EdgeJudge (not ceScore); daemon.py injects ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS=0; judge._JUDGE_TIMEOUT clamped to 120s. Smoke: A3 PASS, A1/A2 show deterministic-prune fallback (claude_p safety refusal on "secret token" phrasing in smoke prompt — code path correct). Commit: e90dd95.
